guidance: So, in some senses, we've internally looked at a target of exchanging $600 odd million in flows for the current financial year.
And I think out of the $600 - 650 million of flows, we're fairly confident we'll get there by March end.
risks: Benchmark indices stayed under pressure through the quarter, weighed down by persistent FPI selling, global rate concerns, and geopolitical uncertainty.
 We remain mindful of the near-term challenges, including market volatility, competition, evolving regulation, and pressure on costs.
focus: Resident Indians want to invest globally, global institutions are refocusing on India, and Gift City is opening new opportunities in asset management and broking.
 Looking ahead, our priorities remain clear in wealth, focus on adding new clients, raising RM productivity, and scaling reference across 360 ONE ecosystem.
In asset management, we will keep sharpening our alternates offering, expand our institutional reach, diversify domestic distribution, and build out the SIF platform.
